jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join a collaborative engineering team where technical expertise and personal wellbeing are valued.

The Role

Contribute to software engineering across the development lifecycle.
Support CI/CD and automation workflows.
Work with container-based environments using Kubernetes and Docker.

What You'll Need

Experience with Linux administration, CI/CD and automation.
Experience with Kubernetes and Docker.
TS/SCI clearance with a Full-Scope Polygraph is required.
AWS and scripting experience are preferred.

What's On Offer

Work in Linthicum, MD, with potential telework up to 2 days per week.
100% company-paid medical premiums and 32 days of PTO.
An 11% non-matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting, plus flexibility to trade select benefits for a higher hourly rate.
Annual stipends for professional development, personal technology and wellness.

Apply via Haystack today!

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Help turn software prototypes into working applications with responsibility across development and deployment.

The Role

Evaluate software and support system design and deployment
Develop and adapt full-stack web applications in cloud environments
Integrate databases, APIs and AI/ML models
Work independently, with local travel as needed

What You'll Need

Bachelor's with 9+ years of experience, Master's with 7+ years, or PhD/JD with 4+ years
Active TS/SCI clearance with polygraph
Full-stack development experience, including client-side development, APIs, data integration and databases
Experience with Linux administration, scripting, cloud platforms, web application deployment and AI/ML models

What's On Offer

Part-time, on-site work in Chantilly, Virginia
Day shift
Target salary range: $160,001 - $200,000, based on experience and other factors

Apply via Haystack today!
